headline: MPS Limited: NCLT-convened Unsecured Creditors Meeting Held
sum: MPS Limited held a formal meeting of unsecured creditors convened by the NCLT, signalling progress in its corporate insolvency resolution process under the IBC 2016.
implication: Creditors' approval of a resolution plan at this stage is material to the timeline and outcome of the CIRP; the framework requires unanimous/statutory majority votes on the insolvency professional's proposed plan, a critical gating step before NCLT approval.
detail: MPS Limited formally notified the NSE that an NCLT-convened meeting of unsecured creditors was held on 22 August 2026. This is a statutory step in the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The meeting would have addressed the insolvency professional's proposed resolution plan. Outcomes (approval, rejection, or amendments) determine the path forward-either approval leading to NCLT confirmation, or extension/liquidation.
